feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 20 September 2026 11:00am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Sunday, 20 September 2026 at 11:00am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds at first.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure in the Norwegian Sea and high pressure near the Bay of Biscay extending a ridge across the area.


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing 4 or 5 around midday, then backing West or Southwest 3 or 4 this afternoon. Further backing South or Southwest this evening, then increasing 3 or 4 occasionally 5 later.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, falling slight this afternoon.


##Weather##

Fair, then occasional rain or drizzle tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain or drizzle later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southwest 3 or 4 occasionally 5, decreasing 3 or 4 tomorrow afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Occasional rain or drizzle at first tomorrow morning. Risk of mist patches later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain, drizzle or mist patches.
